name: The Arrabelle, Vail Square
insider_take: The Arrabelle stands as Vail's crown jewel, where European alpine elegance meets Colorado mountain luxury in the heart of Lionshead Village.
whats_special: This ski-in/ski-out masterpiece features the largest rooms in Vail, each with a fireplace and mountain views. The hotel's RockResorts Spa is ranked among America's top destination spas, while its location offers direct access to Vail's legendary Back Bowls - some of the most coveted powder skiing terrain in North America.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 6-8 for panoramic views of both the ski slopes and Gore Creek Valley, and request early access to the heated outdoor pool before the morning ski crowds arrive.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature WYLD restaurant showcases locally-sourced Rocky Mountain cuisine, while the rooftop infinity hot tubs offer stargazing opportunities at 8,150 feet elevation. Take the complimentary village shuttle to explore Vail Village's cobblestone streets and world-class shopping just minutes away.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location in Vail Village
Luxurious European-inspired alpine architecture and design
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
Multiple on-site dining options including fine dining restaurant
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury mountain resort positioning
Seasonal availability with peak winter demand
